question.prompt: Name a player who won the NBA Sixth Man of the Year Award from 1982–83 through 2025–26.

answers.evidence: Bobby Jones won the inaugural award in 1982–83.
Kevin McHale won the award in 1983–84 and 1984–85.
Bill Walton won the award in 1985–86.
Ricky Pierce won the award in 1986–87 and 1989–90.
Roy Tarpley won the award in 1987–88.
Eddie Johnson won the award in 1988–89.
Detlef Schrempf won the award in 1990–91 and 1991–92.
Clifford Robinson won the award in 1992–93.
Dell Curry won the award in 1993–94.
Anthony Mason won the award in 1994–95.
Toni Kukoč won the award in 1995–96.
John Starks won the award in 1996–97.
Danny Manning won the award in 1997–98.
Darrell Armstrong won the award in 1998–99.
Rodney Rogers won the award in 1999–00.
Aaron McKie won the award in 2000–01.
Corliss Williamson won the award in 2001–02.
Bobby Jackson won the award in 2002–03.
Antawn Jamison won the award in 2003–04.
Ben Gordon won the award in 2004–05.
Mike Miller won the award in 2005–06.
Leandro Barbosa won the award in 2006–07.
Manu Ginóbili won the award in 2007–08.
Jason Terry won the award in 2008–09.
Jamal Crawford won the award in 2009–10, 2013–14 and 2015–16.
Lamar Odom won the award in 2010–11.
James Harden won the award in 2011–12.
J. R. Smith won the award in 2012–13.
Lou Williams won the award in 2014–15, 2017–18 and 2018–19.
Eric Gordon won the award in 2016–17.
Montrezl Harrell won the award in 2019–20.
Jordan Clarkson won the award in 2020–21.
Tyler Herro won the award in 2021–22.
Malcolm Brogdon won the award in 2022–23.
Naz Reid won the award in 2023–24.
Payton Pritchard won the award in 2024–25.
Keldon Johnson is listed as the winner for 2025–26.

question.explanation: The award recognizes the NBA's best-performing player coming off the bench. The winners listed for these seasons include three-time recipients Jamal Crawford and Lou Williams; repeat winners count as a single answer.
